production.note: US model year 2021 only. MBUSA published '2021 Mercedes-AMG GT Black Series Specifications' and a 2021 quick reference guide (mbusa-2021-gt-bs-qrg). Motor Authority: "The Black Series name returns to the Mercedes-Benz AMG lineup for 2021" (motorauthority-gt-bs). Motor1 quotes a Mercedes spokesperson: "The GT Black Series was planned to be produced for a period of roughly one year and was not limited in numbers", with 'slightly more than 1,700 units' built (motor1-gt-bs-production).

configuration.note: 'Handcrafted AMG 4.0-Liter V8 Biturbo engine with flat-plane crankshaft'

fuel.note: Inferred from the description of the V8 biturbo engine.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Horsepower @ rpm | 720 @ 6,700-6,900". MBUSA quick reference guide (mbusa-2021-gt-bs-qrg): "720 hp at 6,700-6,900 rpm".

weightLb.note: US curb weight, coupe, 7-speed DCT (the only transmission). Quote (MBUSA specifications sheet): "Curb Weight (lbs) | 3,616", with no estimate label. MBUSA's quick reference guide prints the same figure as "3,616 lbs* (est.)" (mbusa-2021-gt-bs-qrg). Motor Authority (Viknesh Vijayenthiran) also gives 3,616 pounds (motorauthority-gt-bs). See reviewNotes. Mercedes-Benz USA's quick reference guide prints the same figure as '3,616 lbs* (est.)'. The car was sold for one model year, so no final figure exists; kept with weightQualifier 'preliminary', as for the Corvette ZR1 (C7).
